messages:
maria (support): Hey team, ACME's production saw a p95 -> p99 regression starting ~30m ago. Multiple customers reporting 5-12s tail latency for generation calls. No full 5xx flood, but attach/scaleup times spiking and some requests hit fallback path. Can eng-sre take a look?
raj (eng-sre): Looking. Do we have a correlation with Dedicated pool utilization or recent deploys?
maria (support): Their tenant is on dedicated pool dp-42. Utilization is high (90-98%) around billing window. Support console shows attach latency increase + a handful of auth 401s during retries.
oncall-bot: Alert: dp-42 attach_p99=6200ms, queue_length=310, pool_available=2/5 (reported at 2025-11-12T15:12:03Z)
raj (eng-sre): That attach_p99 is consistent with warmup / coldgpu pressure. Lina, any autoscale throttle events or provisioning backpressure on dp-42?
lina (eng-platform): We're seeing a burst of provisioning requests for dp-42 + image-pull queueing in eu-west-1. Autoscaler hit max_attach_rate limit for this pool due to fairshare smoothing. Also kube reported node creation delays ~30-50s (image pull spike).
raj (eng-sre): Can you paste the recent attach logs for a failed attach?
maria (support): Pasting a trimmed portion of the support trace (customer repro):
```
[2025-11-12T15:09:01Z] request id=rid_abc attach_start
[2025-11-12T15:09:03Z] pool_alloc_attempt pool=dp-42 status=queued position=213
[2025-11-12T15:09:35Z] attach_assigned instance=inst-zz warmup=false
[2025-11-12T15:09:41Z] instance_ready failed_kv_cache_init=true
[2025-11-12T15:09:52Z] request id=rid_abc serve_start latency_ms=1200
```
raj (eng-sre): Warmup=false on assign and kv_cache_init failure -> slow start. That long queued position is the scaleup lag. We likely hit oversubscribe where autoscaler queued requests but attach rate limited.
tom (support): Customer provided quick repro curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=redwood-large` — they get 502 for some retries, and p99 is 6s.
lina (eng-platform): Two immediate mitigations: 1) increase pool_min_capacity for dp-42 by +2 to reduce on-demand attaches. 2) temporarily bump attach_rate ceiling for dp-42 for next 15m to drain queue. I'll run a config change if SRE approves.
raj (eng-sre): Approve. Also we should route ACME to fallback hosted variant for critical endpoints while we stabilize. Maria, can you coordinate with sales/devops contact?
maria (support): Reached out to ACME infra lead, they agreed to brief traffic routing. Will provide fallback window.
raj (eng-sre): Action items: 1) Lina: bump min_capacity + attach_rate limit (15m). 2) SRE: investigate why kv_cache_init failing on new instances (possible image/version mismatch). 3) Support: enable expedited fallback for ACME and gather sample request ids. 4) Post-incident: tune fairshare smoothing to avoid attach rate collapse during billing windows.
lina (eng-platform): Applying config now: `POST /internal/pools/dp-42/config {"min_capacity":7,"attach_rate_ceiling":30}` -> started at 2025-11-12T15:20:10Z
oncall-bot: Config change accepted, new min_capacity=7, attach_rate_ceiling=30
raj (eng-sre): Observing metrics... attach_p99 dropped from 6.2s to ~1.1s in 4m, queue_length -> 40. Good initial effect.
maria (support): Customer confirms p99 improved on their side, slow requests still intermittently present but far fewer.
raj (eng-sre): For root cause, hypothesis: fairshare smoothing + image-pull surge caused throttled attach_rate -> long queue -> instances assigned without completing kv cache init due to image pull timeouts. Followups: collect node image-pull latency histogram, examine recent container image retention GC, check for any image registry throttling.
lina (eng-platform): I'll export node/image-pull logs and registry error counts. Creating follow-up ticket: PLAT-8392.
tom (support): Noted for customer comms. We'll update ACME with timeline and next steps.
raj (eng-sre): Thanks. We should also consider proactive warmup for high-value tenants in billing window times. Add to backlog.
maria (support): Closing loop: updating ticket and will keep monitoring until EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
